mapper.select: select i.item_id, i.type, i.title, i.description, i.category_id, i.images, i.location, i.happen_time, i.contact, i.urgent, i.reward, i.status, i.views, i.user_id, i.create_time, c.category_name, u.user_name, u.avatar as user_avatar from item i left join category c on i.category_id = c.category_id left join user u on i.user_id = u.user_id where i.item_id = #{itemId}
